summary: Heavily obfuscated index.js requires manual review
details: The package's index.js is heavily obfuscated, exhibiting classic string-array rotation patterns (e.g., a while(!![]) loop calling.shift() repeatedly with hex-indexed accesses such as 0x2b1, 0x328). Obfuscation alone is not proof of malicious behavior, but it is uncommon for a legitimate utility package and prevents straightforward determination of what the code does at require time. Without de-obfuscation, intent (benign code-protection vs. concealed exfiltration / dropper / credential access) cannot be confirmed.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
